articles.title: Outside groups urge congressional Dems to target corporate interests over Trump
articles.description: Groups and strategists advising Democrats are warning them to use their investigative tools on corporate interests, rather than on President Donald Trump.

articles.title: Binance hackers had 8 weeks of access before $6.3B exploit, Security Alliance estimates
articles.description: The cybersecurity company flagged similar multi-stage intrusion patterns behind other high-profile crypto heists, including the $388 million Bitget hack.

articles.title: AI debt concerns grow as ING reportedly seeks buyers for $500 million of data center loans
articles.description: ING is reportedly seeking bids for about $500 million across 12 data center loans, including debt tied to a New Mexico Stargate site.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds $75K as AI regulation fears see KOSPI halted after 8% crash
articles.description: Bitcoin consolidated as fears over US AI regulation spread to Asia, causing South Korea to announce measures to calm stock-market volatility.

articles.title: Nasdaq sell-off batters Asian chip stocks as SK Hynix, Samsung, Softbank, TSMC tumble
articles.description: Asian technology stocks tumbled Friday, tracking a sharp sell-off on Wall Street overnight that sent the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite into correction territory.

articles.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains starting in 2027
articles.description: Greece has approved a 10% tax on cryptocurrency gains starting in 2027, with an exemption for investors whose annual net gains do not exceed 500 euros.

articles.title: Montana votes to ban corporate political money. Next stop? Probably the Supreme Court
articles.description: Montana voters approved a novel strategy to restrict corporate political spending, setting up a constitutional fight that could reach the Supreme Court.

articles.title: Former FBI Agent Pleads Guilty to Stealing $2.5M in Crypto From 35 Investigations
articles.description: Patrick Yaroch drained wallets using credentials the FBI had collected, then asked ChatGPT for advice on starting a new life in Europe.

articles.title: GOPAX halts crypto trading, withdrawals to move all assets to cold storage
articles.description: South Korea’s GOPAX suspended trading, deposits and standard withdrawals after a hacking threat, with manual withdrawals available through support.

articles.title: Binance’s $6.3B hack leaves questions over hot wallet safeguards
articles.description: Experts say blockchain records show repeated wallet drains but cannot establish Binance’s internal signing controls or transaction limits.

articles.title: Drones are changing warfare. But defense giants are still making billions from old-school weapons
articles.description: The world's biggest defense firms are finding that demand for traditional military equipment remains strong even as drones and AI reshape how wars are fought.

articles.title: Hoax Bomb threats repeatedly disrupt flights across Europe this week. Here’s what we know
articles.description: Dozens of flights across Europe reported bomb threats this week, disrupting air travel across London, Dublin, and Helsinki.

articles.title: Democrat sweep gives markets a reason to rethink path of interest rates
articles.description: Rate hikes could be curbed by an Iran war resolution, slower U.S. growth and fresh fiscal policy — but none are set in stone.

articles.title: Zcash's NU7 Upgrade Goes Live, Recycling 60% of Fees to Fund Future Block Rewards
articles.description: The Network Sustainability Mechanism will reissue removed ZEC from 2031 within the 21 million cap, as the community debates its dev fund.

articles.title: Oil prices set for sharp weekly fall after midterm elections as investors weigh Iran conflict risk
articles.description: Oil prices fell Friday as investors weighed the risk of renewed Iran war escalation after the midterms, alongside prospects for a diplomatic breakthrough.

articles.title: Bitcoin recovers $76,000 level as ETFs shed $430 million after tech rout
articles.description: Bitcoin recovered above $76,000 Friday after dropping below that level during Thursday's tech-driven market rout.

articles.title: Zcash NU7 upgrade goes live, leaves 12,224 ZEC stranded in Sprout pool
articles.description: Zcash’s NU7 upgrade has rendered about $15 million in legacy Sprout funds unspendable, although a future network upgrade could potentially restore access.

articles.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains and 15% levy on DeFi income
articles.description: Investors will have 12 months to declare past crypto gains without late-filing penalties, though questions remain over crypto-to-crypto swaps.

articles.title: Hyperliquid Strategies seeks futures registration for perps
articles.description: The HYPE treasury company spent $785 million on tokens during the quarter and wants to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the US.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs post $530M outflows as election gains evaporate
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs shed a combined $530 million Thursday as Bitcoin fell below $76,000 and US stocks tumbled.
